name: Storm Sorcery
summary: Sorcerers born of storms who move on the wind.

features.name: Wind Speaker
features.summary: You can speak, read and write Primordial (including Aquan, Auran, Ignan and Terran).

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.short: After casting a leveled spell, fly 10 ft. as a bonus action.
features.summary: Immediately before or after you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you can use a bonus action to fly up to 10 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.short: Resist lightning and thunder; leveled spells zap nearby foes.
features.summary: You gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. When you cast a leveled spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, creatures of your choice within 10 ft. take lightning or thunder damage equal to half your sorcerer level.

features.name: Storm Guide
features.short: Control rain and wind around you.
features.summary: You can stop rain falling in a 20 ft. sphere around you, and change the direction of the wind around you each round.

features.name: Storm's Fury
features.short: Reaction: melee attackers take lightning damage and are pushed.
features.summary: When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level and push it up to 20 ft. (STR save negates the push).

features.name: Wind Soul
features.short: Immune to lightning and thunder; fly 60 ft.; share flight.
features.summary: You gain immunity to lightning and thunder damage and a 60 ft. flying speed. As an action, you can give up to 3 + CHA creatures a 30 ft. flying speed for 1 hour (once per short or long rest).
